:::{#exm-integrable-constant}
#### A constant function is integrable

Let $f(x) = 2$ on $[0, 3]$.
For every partition and every choice of sample points,

$$
\ba
\sumin f(x_i^*)\,\change x_i
&= \sumin 2\,\change x_i
&& \text{(} f \text{ is } 2 \text{ everywhere)}
\\
&= 2 \sumin \change x_i
&& \text{(factor out the constant)}
\\
&= 2 \cd (3 - 0)
&& \text{(the widths add up to the length of } [0, 3] \text{)}
\\
&= 6,
&& \text{(multiply)}
\ea
$$

so the sums have the same limit, $6$, for every choice:
$f$ is Riemann integrable on $[0, 3]$ (@def-integrable),
and $\int_0^3 2\,dx = 6$ (@def-riemann-integral).

:::
